tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje phag mo gsang ba kun 'dus kyi tshogs mchod nyer bsdus bzhugs so: tshogs kyi yo byad bsang chu dang bdud rtsis bran la: 1$0000300raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rang byung bde skyong ka pā lar: dam rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ye shes lnga ldan bcud du 'khyil: 'dod yon sprin phung 'phro bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: hūm̐: 'og min zhing dang nyer bzhi'i yul: dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas mchog nas: rab 'byams mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha: tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren gshegs: sarba dhā ka dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: e a ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i: bde ba chen po'i longs spyod kyis: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mchod: dgyes bzhes dam skongs dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: ho: bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nas: bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag kun: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: hūm̐: phyi nang bar chad dgra dang bgegs: mtshan ma tshogs kyi rdzas la stims: rnam shes 'od gsal dbyings su spor: sha khrag tshogs kyi 'khor lor bzhes: sarba shā trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: pheṃ pheṃ: lhag la dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro ging: pho nya mgyogs ma gnas nyul tshogs: dpal gyi pham phab 'di longs la: mi mthun kun sol phrin las sgrubs: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi:

zhes pa 'di'ang a 'dzoms 'brug sprul rin po che nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ 7kun mkhyen pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'i zhal snga nas bstsal pa/ chos tshan mi 'thor ba'i ched rin chen gter gyi mdzod chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba po ni mkha' khyab rdo rje'o// ༈ //mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi tshogs shin tu bsdus pa 'bum ther gsag skabs lta bur grangs gsog bzhugs so// raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ dbyings dang ye shes gnas yul dur khrod nas// rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro rab 'byams tshogs// dur khrod ma mo spyang zhon mched sde 'bum// 'dir gshegs longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul// nyams chag mthol bshags gzung 'dzin dbyings su sgrol// lhag gtor bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ sarba dhā ki nī ma ma ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pa'ang nye bar mkho phyir chos kyi blo gros pas so/// /
